source: Native AWS CloudTrail LookupEvents management Event history; fresh CLI HTTP request-ID captures plus historical uniquely owned probes
scope: Read-only capture in verified 05-prefix account. No resources created/modified/deleted; no account/organization mutation, KMS key creation, trail configuration, broad logging or CloudTrail Lake.

normalization.nativeDocument: CloudTrailEvent JSON was decoded without SDK event modeling; event member presence, names, nulls, empty containers, requestID/eventID/time/region/classification are retained. Lookup wrapper remains separate.
normalization.identifiers: Account -> 000000000000; original caller -> probe-caller; principal/access-key IDs -> stable fixture-identity markers; historical KMS key IDs -> stable UUID-shaped identifiers. Owned synthetic resource names and native request/event UUIDs intentionally retained for correlation.
normalization.network: Numeric source IP -> 192.0.2.1; non-service user agents redacted. TLS host/cipher/version retained.
normalization.secrets: Session tokens, cryptographic material/token/message fields replaced by explicit <fixture-redacted:field> markers only when present. Native HIDDEN_DUE_TO_SECURITY_REASONS remains untouched. SecretAccessKey absence is native, not inserted null.
normalization.sourceAPI: Fresh source API outputs are field/type projections only (CLI-modeled, not raw JSON/XML body). Raw HTTP response request IDs and non-sensitive headers retained. Historical source API references point to owned fixture observations; resource/time correlations explicitly do not claim request-ID equality.

facts: All authenticated IAM and STS API requests are logged; sufficiently valid non-authenticated AssumeRoleWithSAML/AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity requests can also be logged.
AssumeRole, AssumeRoleWithSAML and AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity are readOnly=true but retain responseElements except secretAccessKey. Session tokens are not universally suppressed by native CloudTrail.
AssumeRoot, GetFederationToken and GetSessionToken are readOnly=false with responseElements included.
SourceIdentity can be recorded in assumption request/response and subsequent userIdentity.sessionContext.
KMS cryptographic APIs are management events, not CloudTrail data events.
Plaintext input and cryptographic responses are omitted; GetKeyPolicy response is omitted. Encryption context may be logged.
Certain key mutations add responseElements.keyId with affected key ARN even when API response is empty.
Lookup resource aliases are not identical to event document resources.
Encrypt, Decrypt and GenerateDataKey are Read management events.
KMS can be excluded with ExcludeManagementEventSources kms.amazonaws.com, independently of data event selectors.
Trail selector exclusions do not remove management events from LookupEvents history.
All Account Management API calls are logged.

GetAlternateContact example has responseElements=null; returned contact values are not logged. Documentation examples use lowerCamelCase request fields, but fresh native GetRegionOptStatus here uses RegionName verbatim.
All Organizations API calls are logged; lookup must use us-east-1.
Async result notifications such as CreateAccountResult are distinct AwsServiceEvent records, not API responses.
Action is logged in the account taking the action. No organization trail/configuration change is needed for Event history.
SQS data events require advanced selectors using AWS::SQS::Queue. GetQueueAttributes/GetQueueUrl/ListQueues are data, not management.
ListQueues data-event resource ARN ends in wildcard *.
Every other EventBridge API operation is management.
Data resource types: AWS::Events::EventBus for PutEvents, AWS::Events::EventSource for PutPartnerEvents; successful global-endpoint PutEvents additionally includes AWS::Events::Endpoint.
Use documented management-operation allowlist and native eventName mappings, not only verb prefixes. Many Lambda names include API date/version suffixes.

CreateFunction/UpdateFunctionConfiguration environment variable content and CreateFunction/UpdateFunctionCode/PublishLayerVersion ZipFile content are omitted. This native CreateFunction retains empty environment/code container objects.
Invoke data events use AWS::Lambda::Function; LambdaESMDisabled is a distinct service data event.

derivedProjectionRules: Classification is per operation. Do not infer KMS category or STS readOnly from whether credentials/ciphertext are produced, nor SQS classification from Get/List verbs.
Preserve native eventName separately from public API operation, especially Lambda date/version suffixes.
Build request/response projections from operation-specific allowlists, not generic SDK serialization or blanket lowercasing: native Account GetRegionOptStatus requestParameters has RegionName.

Keep explicit null, absent members, empty object and empty array distinct. Successful GetCallerIdentity/GetRole/GetRegionOptStatus management events have null responses. Organizations DescribeOrganization has empty LookupEvents.Resources, while its event.resources contains the organization ARN, accountId and AWS::Organizations::Organization type.

Native STS credentials contain accessKeyId/sessionToken/expiration but omit secretAccessKey. The fixture redacts sessionToken and identity values itself. To satisfy stackd no-token logging safety, suppress sessionToken as a deliberate security divergence, never claim native AWS universally suppresses it.
GetFederationToken/GetSessionToken/GetWebIdentityToken are not readOnly just because their names start Get. Captured GetWebIdentityToken errors remain readOnly=false.
IAM GetRole native API error NoSuchEntity maps to CloudTrail errorCode NoSuchEntityException. Do not force wire error codes into the event unchanged.

KMS Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey use Management/readOnly=true, null cryptographic responseElements, no plaintext/ciphertext output. Some early validation/not-found errors have requestParameters=null and no resources, not echoed inputs.

KMS DisableKey has injected responseElements.keyId ARN. Mutation LookupEvents aliases include key UUID and ARN; crypto lookup resource entries may omit ResourceType and can be empty despite document resources.

Keep LookupEvents.Resources separate from document resources. IAM CreateRole has three lookup aliases (name, principal ID, ARN) but no document resources. STS AssumeRole has credential/assumed-role/role lookup aliases while document resources identify the assumed IAM role.

Do not synthesize document resources from lookup aliases: Lambda create/delete/config operations captured here omit document resources despite AWS::Lambda::Function lookup entries; SQS queue management events contain AWS::SQS::Queue document resources.
STS sourceIdentity appears in successful AssumeRole request/response and later assumed-role userIdentity.sessionContext. Keep role/session identity separate from originating IAM caller identity.

Global IAM/Organizations activity is queried in us-east-1. STS regional and explicit global endpoints are retained independently in tlsDetails/additionalEventData; do not replace native awsRegion based solely on endpoint naming.
limitations: Native coverage is representative operation/error shapes, not every IAM/KMS/Organizations/Account API. Unobserved operations rely only on separately labeled official contracts.

Historical STS resource/time/sourceIdentity and KMS creation metadata correlations are weaker than precise HTTP request-ID equality; historical probes did not retain those per-call request IDs. Native CloudTrail request/event IDs remain exact.

GenerateDataKey native capture is an owned missing-alias NotFoundException, readOnly=true/Management; successful GenerateDataKey response suppression is documentation-derived. No KMS key was created or used by this capture.
Account/Organizations captures are fresh GetRegionOptStatus and DescribeOrganization only. No account/contact data, existing policies, organization writes or async result events were retained.

No fresh STS credentials issued or IAM role created; AssumeRole/sourceIdentity/GetFederationToken/GetSessionToken captures reuse historical owned sessions. No native AssumeRoot/SAML/WebIdentity assumption success is claimed.
Source API output shapes use AWS CLI models. CloudTrail requestParameters/responseElements/resource null-versus-omitted distinctions come from native CloudTrailEvent JSON itself.

Bounded service-source lookups returned pages containing unrelated history transiently in memory. Only exact owned references or this capture fresh request IDs were retained; no unrelated event documents are included.
No tests/build/formatter/linter/project validation ran. Native read calls and exact LookupEvents correlations are the experiment proof.
